summary.intent: Execute phase 19.1 (Extract Core Crypto SDK as Shared Package) waves 1–4, then drive the checkpoint verification for plan 19.1-05 (Rewire Web App Hooks to SDK) through Playwright to confirm SDK integration correctness.
summary.outcome: Waves 1–4 executed successfully. Checkpoint verification revealed six SDK integration bugs, all diagnosed and fixed through Playwright-driven UI testing and SDK-level integration tests. 9/10 operations verified working; delete-to-bin remains a known gap.

repo: @cipherbox/api-client generated functions require an explicit `setApiClientConfig()` call before use — the instance is not auto-configured from app bootstrap, so any SDK path that calls generated IPNS functions silently fails without it.

The old upload service and the SDK both write to the same IPNS records independently, creating irreconcilable 409 conflicts. The only clean fix is routing all mutations through a single writer (the SDK).
Folder entries use a UUID `id` field in the children array — the `createFolder` return value was incorrectly using `ipnsName` as the store key, breaking navigation into newly created folders.

`deleteToBin` in the SDK silently falls back to hard delete when `client.loadBin()` has not been called. The old `initializeBin` service must fully complete before SDK `loadBin()` can find the bin IPNS record.

The web app's download and text-editor paths used a completely separate IPNS resolution chain (`ipns.service.ts` → `custom-instance.ts`) from the SDK, explaining why upload worked but download/edit failed after the rewire.
`updateFolderMetadataAndPublish` in sdk-core had no 409 retry logic; the old upload service had `withConflictRetry` + `resyncFolder` to handle stale sequence numbers.
SDK integration tests require a real API — `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET` env var enables the test-login endpoint, bypassing OTP for vitest runs.

code.finding: setApiClientConfig() must be called here during SDK init, passing authToken and baseURL, so all @cipherbox/api-client generated functions are configured before any SDK operation runs.
ensureFolderRegistered must skip (not overwrite) if the SDK already has the folder — overwriting corrupts the SDK's internal sequence number and IPNS private key with stale store data.
createFolder must return the UUID `id` from the FolderEntry (not ipnsName) so the Zustand store can look up the folder by the same id used in the children array.

updateFolderMetadataAndPublish needs a single 409-retry that re-resolves the current IPNS sequence number — without this, any stale seq (from a previous session or parallel writer) causes silent hard deletes or upload failures.
Rewired from old two-step (upload.service + useFileOperations.addFiles) to client.uploadFile() — the old dual-path caused irreconcilable IPNS sequence conflicts with folder CRUD operations.
Rewired to use client.downloadFromIpns() — the old service used a different axios instance and IPNS resolution path that decryption failed against SDK-uploaded files.
Rewired to use client.downloadFromIpns() for the same reason as useFileDownload — old resolution path caused decryption failure on SDK-written files.

workflow: User expects Claude to drive Playwright headed sessions autonomously — not ask the user to manually verify UI operations. Only request user input when you genuinely cannot observe the result.
Use random email per Playwright test run to get a clean vault and avoid state pollution from previous runs.
SDK-level vitest integration tests are valuable for isolating whether a bug is in the SDK or the web app layer — write these before debugging UI symptoms.
pnpm workspace packages need explicit rebuild (`pnpm --filter @cipherbox/X build`) after source changes; the vite dev server hot-reloads web app but does not rebuild workspace packages.
Commits should be atomic per logical fix — not batched by file or PR.

friction: Background task notifications arrived out-of-order, causing repeated confusion about which test run's output was being read — required manual cross-referencing of task IDs.
Phase number typo (9.1 instead of 19.1) on first invocation caused an interrupted run that had to be restarted.
The ensureFolderRegistered bridge generated cascading edge cases with every attempted fix (seq number, private key, children sync) — each patch exposed a new conflict with the dual-path architecture.
File input in the upload zone is hidden behind an empty-state overlay in Playwright; had to use JS execution to trigger the file chooser rather than standard click-based upload.
ESM incompatibility (`__dirname` not defined) in E2E test runner required rewriting the debug test away from Node.js path utilities.
IPNS delegated routing causes ~30s timeouts in SDK integration tests due to API retry logic — no workaround, operations do succeed but tests are slow.
pnpm workspace package resolution fails when running standalone Node.js scripts outside the monorepo test runner — had to switch to vitest.
The initial Playwright test used hardcoded selectors ('New Folder') that didn't match actual UI text ('+folder'), requiring a snapshot-driven fix.
open_items: Delete-to-bin: SDK's loadBin() cannot find bin IPNS records created by the old initializeBin service — falls back to hard delete silently. Needs investigation into why the bin IPNS resolution differs between SDK and old service paths.
Wave 5 (plan 19.1-06) not yet executed — final cleanup, import rewiring, and release config.
Pre-existing DTS circular dependency between @cipherbox/core and @cipherbox/crypto causes `pnpm -r run build` to fail; only `--filter` builds succeed.
useFileUpload and useFileDelete were intentionally left on old service patterns (architecturally different flows) — these are untracked gaps in the SDK rewire.
sdk-debug.spec.ts E2E test was created as a debugging aid — decision needed on whether to keep as a regression test or delete.
packages/sdk/src/__tests__/integration.test.ts was created during debugging — needs to be committed or cleaned up.
loadBin() initialization ordering: must fire after old initializeBin service completes, but current implementation may race depending on vault sync timing.
